    if = { limit = { has_global_variable_list = DI_ce_innovations_high_medieval_military } clear_global_variable_list = DI_ce_innovations_high_medieval_military }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable_list = DI_ce_innovations_high_medieval_civic } clear_global_variable_list = DI_ce_innovations_high_medieval_civic }

    if = { limit = { has_global_variable_list = DI_ce_innovations_late_medieval_other } clear_global_variable_list = DI_ce_innovations_late_medieval_other }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable_list = DI_ce_innovations_late_medieval_silk_road } clear_global_variable_list = DI_ce_innovations_late_medieval_silk_road }
    every_culture_innovation = {
        if = {
            limit = { innovation_era = culture_era_tribal }
            DI_cd_categorize_innovation_effect = { PREFIX = DI_ce_innovations ERA = tribal }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { innovation_era = culture_era_early_medieval }
            DI_cd_categorize_innovation_effect = { PREFIX = DI_ce_innovations ERA = early_medieval }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { innovation_era = culture_era_high_medieval }
            DI_cd_categorize_innovation_effect = { PREFIX = DI_ce_innovations ERA = high_medieval }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { innovation_era = culture_era_late_medieval }
            DI_cd_categorize_innovation_effect = { PREFIX = DI_ce_innovations ERA = late_medieval }
        }
    }
}
